recognize_zh: 一串大型單核芽細胞（monoblast），細胞核圓形、染色質細緻並有核仁，細胞質豐富灰藍且布滿小空泡；最上方的芽細胞細胞質空泡內可見被吞噬的紅血球（erythrophagocytosis）。
features: Cluster of large blasts with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm and round to slightly indented nuclei
Fine, lacy chromatin with one or more distinct nucleoli
Numerous small cytoplasmic vacuoles in most blasts
Top blast contains a phagocytosed red cell within a clear vacuole (erythrophagocytosis)
Adjacent small neutrophil and pyknotic cells for size comparison
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large blasts with abundant gray-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm, round to slightly indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and prominent nucleoli, morphologically monoblasts. One blast contains an engulfed red blood cell within a cytoplasmic vacuole. Erythrophagocytosis by leukemic blasts is characteristically associated with acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia and with the KAT6A::CREBBP (t(8;16)(p11.2;p13.3)) fusion. Findings are consistent with acute monoblastic leukemia with erythrophagocytosis; nonspecific esterase cytochemistry, flow cytometry, and cytogenetics are recommended.

ddx.vs: Hemophagocytosis is performed by mature benign histiocytes with low N:C ratio and condensed chromatin, not by nucleolated blasts.
Megakaryoblasts may be vacuolated with cytoplasmic blebs but lack phagocytosis and are CD41/CD61-positive and NSE-negative.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic cytoplasm and are CD138-positive rather than CD14/CD64-positive.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm and coarser chromatin, and express CD10/CD19/surface Ig with MYC rearrangement.
